name: 74103 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74103 (Tulsa) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74103 (Tulsa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
88% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74103 (Tulsa) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 15.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 90% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
